palette: 宣纸白 paper + 太极墨黑 night + 朱砂印 vermilion + 青瓷绿 celadon + 鎏金 gold
typography: heavy hall headings, pill stake chips, ink-circle label blocks, double-frame seal verdicts
composition: each scene is a push-hall mat: attacker and defender arcs circle the five stake posts, yin-yang boards split casual vs imagined defense, and the counter matrix rows read like push-hands sequences
surface: paper grain, ink stake rings, pill chips, dashed retreat routes, double-frame seals; no glossy panels
motion: arcs enter with the attack, stake posts light in checklist order, seals land as verdicts; no idle loops
transition: the paper mat persists while each scene re-stages the push
